select n.id, n.title, n.dates, n.types, n.hits, n.id as newsId, f.create_time as createTime, (select count(*) from news_favorite where news_id = n.id) as favoriteCount from news_favorite f left join New_Notice n on f.news_id = n.id where f.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and n.deletes = 0 order by f.create_time DESC
